Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Smothered Hamburger Steak & Onion Gravy 🤎  If you’ve got ground beef and you’re tired of making the same thing, try this! These homemade hamburger steaks are smothered in a rich onion gravy and are the definition of comfort food. Ingredients: Hamburger Steaks * 2 lbs ground beef * 1 egg * ½ cup breadcrumbs * 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp seasoning salt * ½ tsp black pepper Onion Gravy * 1 large onion, sliced * 2 tbsp butter * 2 tbsp flour * 2½ cups beef broth * 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * Black pepper, to taste Instructions: 1. Mix the ground beef with the egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, and seasonings. 2. Form into 5–6 oval patties. 3. Brown the patties in a hot skillet for about 4–5 minutes per side, then remove and set aside. 4. Add butter and sliced onions to the same skillet and cook until soft and golden. 5. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for about 1 minute. 6. Slowly pour in the beef broth while stirring. 7. Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and black pepper. 8. Let the gravy simmer until it begins to thicken. 9. Add the hamburger steaks back to the skillet and spoon the gravy over them. 10. Cover and simmer for 10–15 minutes, or until the meat is fully cooked and the gravy is thick. Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite vegetable on the side. 🤤 Save this one for your next comfort-food dinner! #HamburgerSteak #GroundBeefRecipes #ComfortFood #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipes

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

😮‍💨 263 Cal Chicken Caesar Salad Chalupas 📍 My high protein chalupa series has been super viral and I think I might’ve the best one yet! ✅ Macros for each Chalupa: 263 Cals, 15g Carbs, 8g Fat, 36g Protein ✅ Macros (32g) Caesar Dressing: 29 Cals, 0.5g Carbs, 1.75g Fat, 3g Protein ✳️ 29 Cal Caesar Dressing:  227g Plain Non Fat Greek yogurt Juice from ½ Fresh Lemon 14g Olive Oil 30g Worcestershire sauce 10g Dijon Mustard 24g Grated parmesan cheese 3 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon Kosher salt Water to desired consistency ✳️ Caesar Salad: 300g Romaine 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for Chicken Caesar Dip: 16oz Chicken Breast 1 ½ tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 1 tsp Salt ½ tsp Black Pepper ½ tsp Paprika ½ tsp Dried Parsley 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for 1 Chalupa: 1 Josephs Pita 4g Parmesan 12g Part Skim Mozzarella 1/4th Batch of Chicken Caesar Dip Cooking Spray (added 1g fat to macro per chalupa) ❇️ Directions: 1️⃣ Take your chicken breast and pat dry with a paper towel. Then flatten. I just use my fist lol. 2️⃣ Then season both sides with seasoning mix recipe above. Air fry on 400 degrees F for 9-10 minutes. 3️⃣ While that’s cooking, make your caesar dressing by adding all your ingredients into a bowl and mixing. 4️⃣ Now chop up your chicken breast once done and add to a bowl. Combine with the buffalo caesar dressing 1/6th caesar dressing. 5️⃣ Chop up 300g romaine and add 1/6th caesar dressing to it. Can add more but we don’t want the romaine to be soggy. 6️⃣ Now put together your chalupas. Lay one pita down then add to on side 6g mozzarella, 2g parmesan, 1/4th of your chicken caesar dip, 2g parmesan, 6g mozzarella. 7️⃣ Fold your chalupa tightly. Spray both sides with cooking spray and add to air fryer on 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. I added some ramekins on top of each one to make sure they stayed closed while in the air fryer. 8️⃣ Once done, open them up, add your caesar salad and enjoy! #caesarsalad #chalupa #airfryer #highproteinmeals#mealprep

Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest. Top with cheddar and paprika and bake at 325°F until hot and bubbly. 6. Serve the mac and cheese topped with honey chipotle chicken, ranch and parsley. #chicken #cheese #chipotle #dinner #recipe

videos.caption: This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Honey-garlic pork chops , green beans,  and cheesy scalloped potatoes :) With recipe:  honey-garlic pork chops: Season your pork chops generously on both sides with garlic, onion, pepper, Tony Chachere’s, or any of your favorite seasonings. Heat a little oil in a pan and cook the chops on both sides until fully cooked, then remove them from the pan. In the same pan, add 2–3 tablespoons of butter, minced garlic, honey, and a splash of Worcestershire sauce, and simmer until the sauce is fragrant and slightly thickened. Return the pork chops to the pan, coat them in the sauce, and serve. cheesy scallop potatoes: Melt half a stick of butter in a medium-high heat pan, then add a tablespoon of flour and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of milk and 1 cup of heavy cream, season to your liking, and stir in a handful of mozzarella and a handful of cheddar cheese. In an oven-safe dish, layer your thinly sliced, uncooked potatoes and pour the cheese sauce over them. Sprinkle extra shredded cheese on top, along with parsley for color. Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour, or longer until the potatoes are fork-tender. If needed broil for 4–5 minutes to get a golden, crispy top. #EasyRecipe #grandma #nostalgia #food #recipeideas

Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thigh Rice Bake is an easy dinner the whole family likes!  INGREDIENTS 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs Olive oil  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning 1 onion, chopped 1 tbsp minced garlic  1/2 cup Parmesan Garlic sauce  4 oz cream cheese  1 1/2 cups Jasmine rice 2 1/2 cups chicken broth  1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese  Parmesan cheese Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS Add 2 lbs of boneless skinless chicken thighs to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning.  Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little bit of oil. Quickly sear the chicken thighs for a couple of minutes on each side and remove them from the skillet.  Turn the heat down to low and add the chopped onion, rice, minced garlic, cream cheese, Parmesan garlic sauce, and chicken broth to the skillet. Bring to a simmer and stir.  Add this mixture to a greased 9x13 casserole dish. Add chicken thighs to the rice and cover with foil. Bake at 375 degrees F for 40 minutes or until the chicken thighs reach an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees (ideally 185 degrees F) and the rice is cooked.  Remove the foil and add shredded mozzarella cheese. Place the chicken and rice casserole back in the oven under broil for just a couple of minutes to melt the cheese. Top with parmesan cheese and parsley. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #easydinners #chickenthighs

videos.caption: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. В поединке против американца Джастина Гейджи угол Илии принял решение снять бойца перед началом 5-го раунда из-за тяжелых травм (у него диагностировали перелом глазницы). ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender.  Service with rice and enjoy ❤️ #polloguisado #chickenstew #puertoricanfood #dinnerideas #recetas

Creamy Garlic Chicken and Pasta Bake Ingredients 1. Boneless, skinless chicken breasts – 1½ lb 2. Rotini pasta – 12 oz 3. Mozzarella cheese – 2 cups, shredded 4. Parmesan cheese – 1 cup, grated 5. Heavy cream – 2 cups 6. Cream cheese – 4 oz, softened 7. Chicken broth – 1 cup 8. Garlic – 5 cloves, minced 9. Unsalted butter – 3 tbsp 10. Olive oil – 1 tbsp 11. Italian seasoning – 2 tsp 12. Garlic powder – 1 tsp 13. Dried parsley – 1 tsp 14. Red pepper flakes – ¼ tsp 15. Salt – 1 tsp 16. Black pepper – ½ tsp 17. Fresh parsley – 2 tbsp, chopped Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9×13-inch baking dish with a small amount of the olive oil. 2. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rotini until just shy of tender according to the package directions. 3. Drain the pasta well and set it aside, reserving ½ cup of the pasta water in case the sauce needs thinning later. 4. Pat the chicken breasts dry and season both sides with the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 5. Heat the olive oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then sear the chicken for 5–7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 6. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and allow it to rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into bite-sized pieces. 7. Reduce the skillet heat to medium and add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, followed by the minced garlic, cooking for about 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, then whisk in the softened cream cheese until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Stir in the Parmesan cheese, dried parsley, and red pepper flakes, then simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. 10. Add the cooked pasta and sliced chicken to the creamy garlic sauce, tossing gently until everything is thoroughly coated. 11. If the sauce is too thick, stir in a small amount of the reserved pasta water until it reaches a smooth, creamy consistency. 12. Transfer the creamy chicken pasta into the prepared baking dish and spread it into an even layer. 13. Cover the entire surface with the shredded mozzarella and sprinkle the remaining Parmesan evenly over the top. 14. Bake uncovered for 18–22 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden, then broil for 1–2 minutes for a deeper toasted finish. 15. Let the pasta bake rest for 5 minutes, garnish generously with fresh parsley, and serve hot with garlic bread or a crisp green salad. Follow for more easy and delicious homemade comfort food recipes!

Medicube... what is really going on? Medicube Sudan Red dye scandal. On 24th July 2026, Hong Kong Customs issued a warning to consumers to stop using Medicube's PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream after its government laboratory detected Sudan Red, a banned carcinogenic industrial dye. Medicube has responded by releasing an independent South Korean lab (Intertek) report showing that Sudan Red was 'Not Detected’ The investigation is still ongoing and we do not have all of the information to make definitive conclusions yet. This is not the first time Medicube have been under question due to possible Sudan Red contamination. In late 2025, there was a massive recall of certain red-tinted skincare products in China and Taiwan due to Sudan Red dye contamination traced back to raw material suppliers. Medicube denied being affected by this however they introduced a new formulation in March 2026 for their PDRN pink collagen capsule cream. As skincare consumers, we often assume that products on the shelves are safe. Cases like this are a reminder of why independent third-party testing plays such a vital role in protecting consumer safety. @oneeyebeauty_official 's website has a useful guide for spotting fake products online

🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep — just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients 	•	4 chicken breasts 	•	Salt & pepper 	•	Garlic powder 	•	Oregano 	•	1 jar pesto 	•	6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended): 	•	Fresh tomato slices 	•	Fresh basil 	•	Balsamic glaze 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches 165°F internal temperature. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake or broil for 10–15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Crack Chicken Bake 🐔🧀🥓🍲🔥 RECIPE ⬇️ Ingredients: Chicken Breast Cream Cheese Sour Cream Jalapeños  Bacon Colby Jack Cheese Seasonings: Paprika Seasoned Salt Black Pepper Garlic Powder Ranch Seasoning Onion Powder Instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Cut your chicken into bite-sized pieces and add them to a 7x11 baking dish. Season the chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, seasoned salt, and paprika. Mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated. In a separate bowl, add one block of softened cream cheese and season with garlic powder and pepper. Add a spoonful of sour cream, one diced jalapeño, 3 pieces of crumbled bacon, a handful of Colby Jack cheese, and one packet of ranch seasoning. Mix until well combined. Spread the mixture evenly over the chicken. Top with additional cheese and bacon. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and the top is hot and bubbly. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Tornado Cake Ingredients For the cake: 2 cups flour 2 cups sugar 2 eggs  1 20 oz can crushed pineapple, undrained  1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp vanilla For the topping: 1 cup sugar ⅔ cup evaporated milk ½ cup butter ½ tsp vanilla ¼ tsp salt 1 cup sweetened flake coconut 1 cup chopped pecans Instructions Make the cake: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Coat a 9" X 13" baking pan with cooking spray. 2. Mix flour, sugar, eggs, pineapple, baking soda and vanilla in a large mixing bowl until combined. 3. Pour batter into prepared pan; bake 28 – 36 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Crispy Beef Street Corn Tacos 🌽🔥 Ingredients: For the Tacos: -1 lb ground beef -1 packet taco seasoning -2–3 tbsp salsa -1–2 tsp chipotle adobo sauce (adjust to spice preference) -Small flour tortillas -Shredded cheese For the Street Corn Topping: -1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese -Splash of water (for blending) -1 to 1 1/2 tbsp light mayo -1 cup corn -1–2 jalapeños, finely diced -Chopped pickled red onion -2–3 tbsp cotija cheese -Fresh cilantro, chopped -Everything But The Elote seasoning -Juice of 1 lime For Finishing: -Hot honey -Lime wedges Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook until charred. Remove from heat and let cool. 2. For the Street Corn Mixture: Add cottage cheese and a splash of water to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl and mix in: -charred corn -mayo -diced jalapeños -pickled red onion -cotija -cilantro -lime juice -elote seasoning to taste Set aside. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in taco seasoning, salsa, and chipotle adobo sauce. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until it’s all absorbed.  4. Place flour tortillas on a baking sheet (spray with oil if needed). Add a layer of shredded cheese, spoon in taco meat, then top with more cheese. Fold each tortilla in half. Place a baking rack on top of the tacos to help keep them closed while baking. Spray with avocado oil.  5. Bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes, or until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 6. Top warm tacos with the street corn mixture. Finish with a drizzle of hot honey and squeeze of lime. SO GOOD 😮‍💨😮‍💨 #fyp #explorepage✨ #easyrecipe #dinner #healthy

These viral Parmesan crusted jammy eggs are my new favorite way to eat hard boiled eggs. Crispy Parmesan, creamy yolks, and topped with an herby cottage cheese mix for even more protein. For the Parmesan crusted eggs: Slice your jammy eggs in half. Add a pile of Parmesan cheese to a hot nonstick pan and place the eggs cut-side down directly onto the cheese. Let the Parmesan crisp and harden, then remove from the pan and top with the herby cottage cheese mixture. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

CRISPY Honey Soy Garlic Chicken BIG M STYLE 🤭 Marinade: • 1½ lbs boneless chicken thighs (skin-on for extra crispiness) • 2 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • Drizzle of sesame oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • ¼ tsp white pepper Batter: • ½ cup cornstarch • ¼ tsp white pepper • ¼ tsp onion powder Sauce: • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 1 tbsp neutral oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 2½ tbsp soy sauce • 2½ tbsp honey • 1 tbsp brown sugar • ½ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) • Pinch of MSG (optional) Directions: 1. Clean and trim the chicken, then marinate with all marinade ingredients for at least 3 hours. 2. Mix the batter ingredients, coat the chicken evenly, and let it rest for 5 minutes. 3. Fry at 350°F for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 4. While the chicken cooks, melt the butter and oil over low heat. Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then stir in the soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, and MSG (if using). Simmer until the sauce is glossy. 5. Drizzle the sauce over the crispy chicken (or toss to coat) and serve with steamed rice and veggies of choice.  #fyp #crispy #dinner #dinnerideas #chicken

Is travel to Morocco safe for women?   Generally, I would say yes, it is definitely a safe place for women to travel, and I think the bad reputation mainly comes from Marrakesh. There are so many amazing cities to visit in Morocco. Where should you visit in Morocco? Fes is one city that I really loved. Another city to visit in Morocco? Definitely go to Essaouira, but also to Casablanca, and Tangier. Do not forget about the desert! The best desert I’ve been to in potentially my life is in Merzouga! Make sure you do not go to the Agafay desert… you need to make sure you go to the further desert because it is absolutely gorgeous   I do think that I explain in my video, however, it goes a little bit deeper than just a city having small streets and being uncomfortable, because of the way that men act I think it is directly tied tourism , so while I would not say avoid Marrakesh, I would just say, be vigilant and ignore, and that speak to you if you’re alone. The bottom line is travel to Morocco is safe. Tourism and Morocco is safe. Moroccans are very kind in hospital people, so should you travel to Morocco? Yes. Morocco is safe for solo female travelers. As with anywhere else be sure to be vigilant and if you feel extra uncomfortable, maybe just skip Marrakech!  ##marrakech##solotravel##2024travel##visitmorocco##moroccangirl##femaletraveler##travelvlog

Homemade Honey Bun Recipe 🍯🌼 The long awaited honeybun recipe! I know these don’t have any honey but they’re still so good! Recipe: Yeast mixture: 2/3 cup warm milk (160g) 1/4 cup warm water (60g ) 2 1/4 tsp yeast (7g) 1 tbsp granulated sugar (12.5g) Wet ingredients: 1/3 cup granulated sugar (67g) 1/4 cup butter, melted (57g) 2 tbsp oil (28g) 2 large eggs 2 tsp vanilla extract Dry ingredients: 4 cups + 1/2 cup flour, divided (520g) + (65g) 1 1/4 tsp salt ** Cinnamon to dust before rolling Glaze ingredients: 3 cups powdered sugar 3-6 tbsp HOT water 1/2 tbsp vanilla extract 1 tbsp corn syrup (optional) 1.)1.) In a bowl combine your milk, water, yeast and 1 tbsp sugar, allow to sit for 5 minutes to activate (you can skip the wait if you know your yeast is active or your using instant). Then whisk in your 1/3 cup sugar, butter, oil, eggs and vanilla extract.  2.)Then mix in your 4 cups of flour and salt and add the extra 1/2 cup flour as needed,  (You may or may not need the extra flour, add a tbsp at a time or until the dough is tacky but not sticky) knead for 10-15 minutes. Shape the dough into a ball then place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover and rest for 45-60 minutes in a warm place or until doubled in size. 3.) Once doubled in size roll out into a rectangle then sprinkle on your cinnamon, rub it in gently and roll into a log. Cut your buns out than place on a tray, slightly flatten then cover and proof for about 30 minutes or until rolls have risen until doubled in size 4.) Once rolls have doubled in size bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until slightly golden brown (Avoid overbaking as it can cause the rolls to become dry) 5.) Whisk together the glaze ingredients and while still warm dip the buns into the glaze, cool or enjoy warm 🫶 ** Tips - Bake the rolls until slightly golden brown, since they’re baked freeform they bake faster and can over bake easier leading to dry rolls - After cutting the rolls tuck the tail end of the dough strip under the bun to prevent unraveling while baking - I Like to spray my buns (or any yeasted dough baked individually) with water to help them stay soft (optional) #honeybakes2 #honeybun #homemade #fromscratch #bakingrecipe

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. ENJOY! . . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipe #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #whatsonmyplate

Valentine’s Day Dinner - Ep. 2: Spicy Vodka Chicken Parm Pasta 🔥❤️ recipe ⬇️ 1 large chicken breast, butterflied and pounded thin 2 eggs 2 cups seasoned breadcrumbs or use panko and season with salt, Italian seasoning, garlic & onion powder  1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Slice chicken breasts in half. Place in a ziplock bag or plastic wrap. Pound with anything heavy until super thin. Dip in egg and then in seasoned breadcrumbs/panko. Press down so the breading sticks. Thoroughly spray with oil and air fry 380F for 10 min. Immediately sprinkle salt over fried chicken. Top with vodka sauce ⬇️ and slices of mozzarella. Air fry again for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted.  Vodka Sauce 1 tbsp olive oil & butter 1/2 large onion, finely chopped 4-6 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes 1 & 1/2 tbsp tomato paste 1 or 2 shots of vodka, wine or broth 1 cup heavy cream 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 3/4 cup Parmesan 2 tbsp butter 8 oz pasta Melt butter and oil in a large pan. Sauté onion until translucent. Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Once fragrant add tomato paste and cook down for a few minutes. Pour in vodka and once most of it evaporates, incorporate heavy cream. Season with Italian seasoning, paprika and Parmesan cheese. Mix in al dente pasta along with more parm, pasta water and butter.  #pasta #chickenparm #vodkasauce #rigatoni #cheese

VIRAL BROWN BUTTER COOKIE RECIPE  Inspired by @Broma Bakery  3/4 cup (170g) unsalted butter 1 cup (212g) light brown sugar 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar 1 large egg + 1 large egg yolk 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 1 3/4 cup (220g) all-purpose flour 3/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda/ baking soda  3/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1 1/4 cups (210g)roughly chopped chocolate Flaky sea salt for sprinkling  Brown the butter over medium-low heat, stirring until golden and nutty. Cool for 5 minutes. Mix browned butter with both sugars, then add the egg, extra yolk, and vanilla. Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt, then stir in chocolate . Chill the dough for at least 1 hour. Scoop onto lined baking sheets and bake at 350°F/170C for 10-12 minutes, until golden around the edges but soft in the middle. Finish with flaky sea salt, let cool slightly, and enjoy 🤎🍪 #cookiedough #icecream #cookiesandicecream #cookieicecream #cookies
